term.income.name: Income
term.income.life: Your uncle gives ₹500 at Diwali; that's money in.
term.income.real: Income = money you receive, from pocket money, a job, a gift or a scholarship.
term.expense.name: Expense
term.expense.real: Expense = money that goes out. Fixed: same each time. Variable: changes.
term.need.name: Need
term.need.simple: Something you must have to live and study.
term.want.name: Want
term.want.simple: Something nice you could live without.
term.want.life: Branded sneakers, a movie with friends.
term.want.real: Want = a non-essential you'd like. Wants are fine when planned.
term.fixedExpense.name: Fixed expense
term.fixedExpense.simple: An expense that stays the same each time, like a bus pass.
term.variableExpense.name: Variable expense
term.variableExpense.simple: An expense that changes, like snacks and outings.
